title: Music Wishlist
shortDescription: Search Deezer, save albums & tracks, follow artists and get release alerts.
fullDescription:
Music Wishlist is your personal wishlist for music: search Deezer and save every album and track you want in one place.

• Search millions of songs and albums on Deezer
• Add tracks, albums and EPs to your wishlist
• Mark the items you already have or downloaded
• Share your wishlist with friends and invite them to add their own
• Follow your favourite artists and get notified about new releases
• Push notifications so you never miss a drop
• Listen to track previews
• Light and dark theme
• Available in English and Spanish

Keep a running list of the albums you want to buy, or just remember that song you heard — Music Wishlist keeps everything organised and lets the people you share it with see what you are after.

Install it on your phone for a fast, app-like experience.
